22 families: 20 with a dark theme and a `-light` twin, and 2 dark-only (synthwave84, vesper).

**Dark**: brothy, catppuccin, dracula, tokyonight, gruvbox, solarized, rosepine, everforest, kanagawa, nord, github, one-dark, flexoki, ayu, cyberdream, iceberg, melange, nightfox, nightowl, oxocarbon, synthwave84, vesper

**Light**: brothy-light, catppuccin-light (latte), dracula-light, tokyonight-light (day), gruvbox-light, solarized-light, rosepine-light (dawn), everforest-light, kanagawa-light (lotus), nord-light, github-light, one-light, flexoki-light, ayu-light, cyberdream-light, iceberg-light, melange-light, nightfox-light (dayfox), nightowl-light (Light Owl), oxocarbon-light

## On this site

The site wears brothy's own palettes too, all 22 families, and it starts in `brothy` (following your system's dark or light). Press <kbd>t</kbd>, or click the family name in the top line, for the same picker as in the app: type to filter, <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> to move, <kbd>tab</kbd> or <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> for dark · light, <kbd>⏎</kbd> to save, <kbd>esc</kbd> to close. The page wears the highlighted theme as you move (with the arrow keys, or the mouse once it moves), and <kbd>esc</kbd> puts your saved theme back. The `◐ dark` / `◐ light` word flips the mode within the family. Synthwave84 and vesper are dark-only, so their light side is struck through. Your choice stays in this browser. The recorded tour and the screenshots keep the `brothy` colors they were recorded in.

## Credits

The brothy themes follow Noodle's theme definitions (Apache-2.0). Additional palettes are adapted from [opencode](https://github.com/sst/opencode) (MIT), and ayu, nightfox, Night Owl, iceberg, oxocarbon, cyberdream, melange, SynthWave '84 and Vesper from their own repositories (all MIT; see [NOTICE](https://github.com/jackMort/brothy/blob/main/NOTICE)), all tuned for contrast. `brothy-light` is original.
